title: Hiking in The Canary Islands - An Immigration Battleground
description: I spent this past week hiking 75km across Gran Canaria, an island often called a “miniature continent” thanks to its diverse biomes. Every leg of our journey felt like a whole different nation, but there was a unifying feature that was ever-present no matter where we found ourselves: the political banners and placards ready for the upcoming election...
